name: Log Physical Disk Health (Windows)
description: Append each physical disk’s health and operational status to a log file on a schedule, so a drive that starts reporting Warning or Unhealthy leaves a record before it fails outright.
commandTemplate: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object FriendlyName, MediaType, HealthStatus, OperationalStatus | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-File -Append '{{logPath}}'"

parameters.label: Log file path
parameters.help: Where to append the disk health snapshot. This reports what Windows already knows about each drive; it is not a full SMART analysis.
